description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named UserSearchFilterParams for filtering user search results within the OrangeHRM system. It extends from a base class FilterParams and includes properties like status, username, userRoleId, empNumber, and hasPassword, along with associated getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed fields for sorting search results.

classes.name: UserSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters for users in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets the default sort field to 'u.userName'.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Returns the user role ID filter value.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID filter value.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: hasPassword
methods.description: Returns whether the filter for having a password is set.

methods.name: setHasPassword
methods.description: Sets the filter for having a password.
